computed_scope: source-pinned convention transport plus unit-S3 low-mode and cumulative-count arithmetic for all three SVT sectors; FULL_SVT does not mean an explicit basis or completeness proof

declared_conventions.exceptional_modes: n=0 scalar is constant with vanishing gradient; n=1 scalar-derived TF Hessian vanishes; n=1 transverse vectors are Killing and their symmetrized gradients vanish; TT tensor sector starts at n=2
declared_conventions.full_label_meaning: FULL_SVT means that scalar, transverse-vector and TT spectral sectors are all present in one bookkeeping packet; it does not assert explicit bases, chirality resolution, Gaunt data or a completeness proof
declared_conventions.geometry: unit round S3 with Ric_ab=2 gamma_ab and scalar curvature 6
declared_conventions.riemann_and_lichnerowicz_definition: R_ikjl=gamma_ij gamma_kl-gamma_il gamma_kj and (Delta_L h)_ij=-D^2 h_ij+R_i^k h_kj+R_j^k h_ik-2 R_ikjl h^kl; for tracefree h this is Delta_rough h+6h
declared_conventions.scalar_derived_tf_hessian: S_ab=D_aD_bQ+(lambda_n/3)gamma_abQ; norm squared (2/3)lambda_n(lambda_n-3); normalized for n>=2; rough eigenvalue lambda_n-6; declared Lichnerowicz eigenvalue lambda_n
declared_conventions.scalar_derived_vector: G_a=lambda_n^(-1/2)D_aQ for n>=1; norm one; rough eigenvalue lambda_n-2; Hodge eigenvalue lambda_n
declared_conventions.scalar_sector: n>=0; lambda_n=n(n+2); rough Delta_0=-D^2 eigenvalue lambda_n; degeneracy d_0=(n+1)^2
declared_conventions.transverse_vector_sector: n>=1; D^aV_a=0; rough Delta_1=-D^2 eigenvalue lambda_n-1; Hodge Delta_H=Delta_1+2 eigenvalue lambda_n+1; combined degeneracy d_1=2n(n+2)
declared_conventions.tt_tensor_sector: n>=2; D^aT_ab=0=T^a_a; rough Delta_2=-D^2 eigenvalue lambda_n-2; declared Delta_L=Delta_2+6 on tracefree symmetric tensors has eigenvalue lambda_n+4; combined degeneracy d_2=2(n-1)(n+3)
declared_conventions.vector_derived_tensor: A_ab=D_aV_b+D_bV_a for transverse unit V; norm squared 2(lambda_n-3); normalized for n>=2; rough eigenvalue lambda_n-5; declared Lichnerowicz eigenvalue lambda_n+1
